printed_title: Delhi Electricity Regulatory Commission (Net Metering for Renewable Energy) (Second Amendment) Guidelines, 2026

candidate_clauses.verbatim_quote: The Distribution Licensee shall complete the technical feasibility analysis within fifteen (15) days from the date of receipt of the application complete in all aspects:
candidate_clauses.topic: Feasibility 15 days; deemed grant; <=10 kW no study

amends_or_supersedes.evidence_quote: the Distribution Licensee shall complete the feasibility analysis for connecting the Renewable EnergySystem to the distribution system within thirty (30) days from the date of receipt of the application..

candidate_clauses.clause_ref: Guideline 3 (substituted), Stage II and cumulative cap
candidate_clauses.verbatim_quote: the cumulative period to be observed by the Distribution Licensee, up to the grant of connectivity, shall not exceed —(a) twenty -five (25) days in the case of a Renewable Energy System above 10 kW, and (b) ten (10) days in the case of a Renewable Energy System up to 10 kW
